purpose: Converge minimap, sea-chart navigation and world guidance into one readable composition for the five gameplay master references.

locks.camera: M213/M214 high/wide oblique gameplay camera remains authoritative
locks.world_truth: minimap and navigation render only objects/targets that actually exist in the current world
locks.movement: mobile Tap-to-Sail and desktop Click-to-Sail remain authoritative
locks.route_authority: M192 island avoidance and M220 final-destination preservation remain unchanged
locks.world_parity: same map, actors, POIs, route authority and gameplay on mobile/web/desktop; only responsive UI sizing differs
locks.hud: circular upper-right minimap; no persistent bottom command/map-selection bar; primary attack remains lower-right

minimap.orientation: north-up with explicit player heading vector
minimap.course: active final Tap-to-Sail destination and local steering bend can be shown without becoming route authority
minimap.density: ordinary markers stay compact; selected/tracked/high-priority markers receive rings rather than excessive labels
